name: opspilot
description: OpsPilot — AI-powered engineering operations and incident investigation platform

scripts.dev:ai: cd services/ai && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web,ai -c blue,magenta,green,yellow "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @opspilot/api && npm run build -w @opspilot/web
scripts.evals: cd services/ai && uv run python -m app.evals.run
scripts.mcp: cd services/ai && uv run python -m app.mcp_server
scripts.contracts: node scripts/contracts.mjs && npm run contracts:api -w @opspilot/api && (cd services/ai && uv run python -m app.contracts)
scripts.contracts:check: npm run contracts && git diff --exit-code -- contracts apps/api/src/generated apps/web/src/lib/generated services/ai/app/generated
scripts.tracing:up: OTEL_ENABLED=true docker compose --profile app --profile tracing up -d --build
scripts.tracing:down: docker compose --profile tracing rm -sf tracing && docker compose --profile app up -d
